query:
SELECT te.id as "id!: Uuid"
           FROM time_entries te
           JOIN projects p ON p.id = te.project_id
           WHERE te.org_id = $1
             AND p.client_id = $2
             AND te.billable = true
             AND te.invoice_id IS NULL
             AND te.state IN ('open', 'approved')
             AND te.spent_date >= $3
             AND te.spent_date <= $4
           ORDER BY te.id
